consumer: run_intruder / load_intruder_payloads (merged with the diagnostic catalog by the loader)
purpose: DECLARATIVE probe values with real detection fidelity — read-only commands, static paths, approved canaries; every hit requires independent verification; never a confirmed vulnerability
status: OPERATOR_APPROVED — dj via VANTA dispatch 2026-11-11 (Intruder-Lite support); dj recalibration word 2026-11-11: payloads must have real pentest detection value ('use o que realmente vão ajudar a gente a encontrar vulnerabilidades')

placeholders.{token}: per-run random hex marker (run_intruder); payloads echo it with the MITR3_ prefix so marker_observed fires on reflection
placeholders.{canary}: operator-approved public HTTPS canary URL, validated by _validate_ssrf_canary; used whole — never prefixed or rewritten

rules: dedupe: entries duplicating values already in the primary catalog (rce_id_subst, rce_printf_* marker echo, lfi_passwd_absolute, lfi_php_filter, ssrf_canary_plain) were removed — the db keeps precedence and the probe budget is not burned twice
payloads stay READ-ONLY and diagnostic — that is what detection requires: no destructive command, no write path, no log poisoning, no gopher/dict scheme bridging
command payloads target high-signal output the signature DB already detects (id, uname, passwd) or reflect the run marker
SSTI arithmetic probes (7*7=49) are marker-free: operator verifies the reflected result in the probe body
values must be safe to render on an operator screen (no raw credentials, no exploit scaffolding)
ssrf payloads never target private/reserved hosts except the loopback/metadata diagnostics that are part of the check itself

rce.notes: newline separator bypasses space/semicolon filters after one decode
reflected 49 = SSTI; verify arithmetic result in probe body
OOB confirmation lands on the canary console; canary origin must be in the scope allowlist

lfi.notes: single-depth encoded variant; survives filters that block '../' before decoding
data:// included + marker echoed = allow_url_include proven
running command line leaks app runtime paths
benign read proving arbitrary path control
include of remote canary = allow_url_include / RFI proven; callback on canary console

ssrf.notes: token in query distinguishes this probe from ssrf_canary_path (token in path)
SSH-2.0 banner in body = internal port open
IPv6 loopback often unfiltered when v4 is blocked
403 confirms internal DNS resolution even without Metadata-Flavor header
fetch function allowing file:// = direct scheme bridge
